holdout_rule: NEVER used for selection. June 2026 is a burned buffer. July–August was already inside the v4–v6 holdout aggregates — this is a cleaner window, not virgin data.

costs.note: Locked book. 10 pt = MT5 points (0.01), not 10 index points. RT ≈ $0.20 slip + ~$0.60 spread. Do not cut slippage or raise lots to chase 1%/20%.

friday: no new entries at or after 14:00 ET
emergency_sl: ATR 1.0 at the signal bar, applied from fill

causality.z_window: prior W closed M5 bars excluding bar i (indexes i-W .. i-1). Bar i is NOT inside μ, σ, or Vμ.
causality.z_bars: consecutive M5 (all hours), not cash-only resampling. Session gate is the entry window only.
causality.exit_mu: running target = typical-price μ on the same exclude-i window at bar j (j-W .. j-1). Including j would leak close[j] into μ while tagging high/low[j].
causality.exit_touch: simulate_exits kind=vwap: bar high/low tags the target (traded through μ / IB level). Not a close-cross.
causality.ib_complete: opening_range_at(..., or_minutes=60). Complete iff bar open >= 10:30 ET. Do not stamp IB during 09:30–10:30.
causality.ib_sweep: after IB is complete: M5 high > IB high or low < IB low. A bar that takes out both sides is skipped (ambiguous).
causality.ib_trigger: the very next M5 (i+1 relative to the sweep) must close back inside [IB low, IB high]. Same-bar close-back does not count.
causality.ib_signal: signal on the close of the return bar; fill = open of the following bar. Do not use the return bar's future.
causality.ib_no_return: if the next bar does not close inside, that sweep is dead; a later bar may become a new sweep. No trade if there is never a return close.

reused_from_trading.clock_or: scripts/us_index_session_core.py NY cash 09:30–16:00 ET; opening_range_at(..., or_minutes=60) is knowable at 10:30
reused_from_trading.exits: simulate_exits kind=vwap + emergency sl + flatten 15:45. Target series = IB midline / opposite IB side, or running rolling typical-price μ
reused_from_trading.split: split_v4: develop et_date < 2026-06-01; holdout et_date >= 2026-07-01; June burned

ib_false_breakout_fade.note: Classic 60m Initial Balance. Fade a stop-run that fails to hold outside. Not the v1 15m OR close-break. Not the v3 same-bar wick fade.
ib_false_breakout_fade.ib: first 60 minutes of NY cash [09:30, 10:30) ET
ib_false_breakout_fade.fade: sweep of IB high → short; sweep of IB low → long
ib_false_breakout_fade.ib_mid: (IBh + IBl) / 2, fixed once IB is complete (running=false)
ib_false_breakout_fade.opposite_ib: long targets IBh; short targets IBl (running=false, taken at signal bar)
ib_false_breakout_fade.exit: target then flatten 15:45; emergency SL ATR 1.0
ib_false_breakout_fade.no_and: Do not AND with H4 / Donchian / XAU / regime

m5_zscore_tick_vol_exhaustion.note: Intraday mean-reversion: stretched typical price plus a tick-volume spike. Not a daily regime.
m5_zscore_tick_vol_exhaustion.typical_price: (H + L + C) / 3 on each closed M5
m5_zscore_tick_vol_exhaustion.z: (P_i - μ) / σ with μ,σ from i-W .. i-1
m5_zscore_tick_vol_exhaustion.session_note: NY cash only. Two windows max. Friday cutoff still applies.
m5_zscore_tick_vol_exhaustion.exit: flatten when bar range tags the current W-bar μ (exclude j); emergency SL ATR 1.0; flatten 15:45

grid_note: Product of the listed family knobs only (8 + 32 = 40). Tighter than v5/v6 on purpose — two new predicates, no padding. The ~80–160 band is a ceiling against thousands, not a quota.
rank_develop: net>0 and trades>=40; rank by profit_factor then expectancy
note: Architectural pivot after v6 starvation: intraday statistical kinetics, not daily macro-gating. New search_id. Do not attach these families to the overlay. 1%/day and 20%/month are goals, not promises.
